CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Fill Nexmon-targeting stdlib gaps: pentest/wireless.prn (monitor-mode/channel control via iw/ip), net/l2socket.prn (AF_PACKET link-layer raw socket), pentest/dot11.prn build side (build-radiotap-header, build-deauth-frame, MAC string parser). Fixed a live-caught string/concat truncation bug on embedded zero bytes. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
